europe_now.title: Banned Russian fuel keeps re-entering EU ports
europe_now.summary: Cargoes of banned Russian fuel have doubled in July, indicating persistent security and economic challenges despite EU restrictions. The re-entry raises concerns about compliance and systemic vulnerabilities in energy supply chains.

europe_now.title: Greece’s aging power grid blamed for catastrophic wildfires
europe_now.summary: Greece’s outdated electricity infrastructure is directly linked to severe wildfires, highlighting systemic risks to public safety and energy resilience. The crisis underscores the need for urgent grid modernization.

top_stories.title: Ceuta Migration Crisis and EU Tech Partnership
top_stories.summary: The EU has established a channel with Meta and TikTok to address the Ceuta migrant crisis, leveraging digital platforms to manage border security. This initiative reflects a strategic shift toward tech-driven solutions for migration challenges.

top_stories.title: Banned Russian Fuel Re-Entry
top_stories.summary: Russian fuel continues to re-enter EU ports despite bans, with cargo volumes doubling in July. This pattern suggests ongoing geopolitical tensions and potential loopholes in enforcement mechanisms.

top_stories.title: Greece’s Power Grid and Wildfires
top_stories.summary: Greece’s failing power grid is identified as a primary cause of catastrophic wildfires, exposing critical infrastructure weaknesses. The event has significant implications for regional disaster preparedness and energy policy.
